_what: Species that cannot be deposited in Pokemon HOME's GTS at all, so recommending one as a chip is recommending something impossible.
_how_we_know: The player, from the game. NONE of this repo's five sources covers HOME's own rules - they are about Champions - so there is nothing to scrape and nothing to check it against. Each entry says who confirmed it and when.
_open_question: Melmetal is a Mythical - he confirmed that too (2026-09-21) - so "HOME's GTS refuses Mythicals" is the obvious reading of one data point. It is treated as INFERRED, not confirmed: the other Mythicals are ranked last and tagged, never dropped, because a wrong guess that hides a chip is worse than one that warns about it. The moment a second Mythical is refused, move it into `blocked` and the rule has earned its place.

Melmetal.note: "melmetal esta bloqueado del gts". He was unsure why - "debe ser porque es un pokemon que no esta presente en muchos juegos o no se".

_why_it_matters: Champions has ZERO Mythicals and ZERO Legendaries - measured over the whole dex - so every Mythical that ever reaches HOME is a species Champions cannot use, which is exactly the pile the GTS recommendations put FIRST. Thirteen of the 23 are obtainable in Pokemon GO, so this is not a one-off.
_the_list_is_derived: Which species are Mythical comes from PokeAPI's is_mythical at the pinned commit, via scripts/fetch_home_dex.py -> data/db/species_flags.json. It is never typed out here.
